sentences.en: The bank came through with the loan we had requested.
sentences.zh: 银行批准了我们申请的贷款。

sentences.en: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.
sentences.zh: 国际货币基金组织拒绝向那个国家提供新的贷款。

sentences.en: Farmers defaulting on loans had to auction off their land.
sentences.zh: 违约农民不得不拍卖他们的土地。
